outlook.statement: Accelerating digital transformation through advanced logistics technology and data-driven operations; Expanding presence across southern and western India; Strengthening partnerships with manufacturing, steel, petrochemical, infrastructure, and emerging industrial sectors; Enhancing fleet efficiency with greater adoption of electric and cleaner fuel vehicles; Building an integrated, sustainable, and customer-centric logistics ecosystem; Sustaining profitability, operational excellence, and long-term value creation.

India's logistics sector is entering a new phase of growth driven by technological innovation, infrastructure modernization, digital integration, sustainability initiatives, and expanding trade and e-commerce activities. Opportunities in robotics, drones, smart warehousing, multimodal logistics parks, green logistics, and digital supply chain solutions are expected to transform the sector, improve competitiveness, attract investment, and support India's ambition of becoming a leading global logistics and manufacturing hub.
India has set an ambitious target of entering the top 25 countries in the LPI rankings by 2030 while reducing logistics costs to below 10 percent of GDP.
The Economic Survey projects GDP growth in the range of 6.8% to 7.2% for FY 2026-27, supported by continued structural reforms, rising investment activity, and robust domestic consumption.

Focused on developing and strengthening manpower base as key driver of long-term growth; opening new branch offices in remote parts of India for network expansion in PTL division; using franchise model where appropriate to mitigate risks; infused additional capital to strengthen financial base and optimize debt-equity ratio for lower financing costs, improved liquidity, and enhanced ability to invest in infrastructure, technology, and network expansion.

Highly optimistic about Projects and ODC/Bulk Business division serving marquee clients (TATA Steel Ltd., GAIL (India) Ltd., Uno Minda Ltd.); strong potential to significantly boost revenue given high entry barriers and limited competition; investing in advanced material-handling equipment and workforce training; dedicated programs to raise safety standards and enhance operational capabilities.

Acquired 10.81% stake in SG Green Logistic Private Limited (SGGL), India's largest operator of heavy commercial electric vehicles (EVs), aligning with long-term vision of sustainable transportation; electricity costs substantially lower than diesel; collaboration provides access to substantial business opportunities while advancing sustainability agenda.

Actively promotes green logistics, raises awareness through ESG campaigns, and integrates sustainable practices into daily operations including adoption of green trucks, energy conservation measures, optimized warehouse management, and comprehensive water and waste management strategies.

The management has adopted focused and aggressive business strategies in all spheres of functions to improve the profitability of the Company. Considering the present business scenario, the Company is expecting to increase in revenue and profitability. The Management is confident of keeping a higher growth ratio in the period to come.
